episode.intent: List the artists who illustrated cards with black borders which are available only in arena.
episode.failed_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(COALESCE(artist, '')) AS artist
FROM cards
WHERE lower(TRIM(COALESCE(borderColor, ''))) = 'black'
  AND lower(TRIM(COALESCE(availability, ''))) = 'arena'
  AND TRIM(COALESCE(artist, '')) <> ''
ORDER BY artist;
episode.remediation_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(COALESCE(artist, '')) AS artist
FROM cards
WHERE lower(TRIM(COALESCE(borderColor, ''))) = 'black'
  AND lower(TRIM(COALESCE(availability, ''))) = 'arena'
  AND TRIM(COALESCE(artist, '')) <> ''
ORDER BY artist COLLATE NOCASE;
